name: mediatermo
description: MediaTermo - geração de termos de sessão de mediação/conciliação para mediadores judiciais

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run start
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=client
